bagPolicy.summary: Only bags smaller than 12 × 12 inches are allowed; clear material is not required. Backpacks and oversize bags are prohibited, and small bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Vic has no own parking; its FAQ points to nearby street parking and a garage across the street at 3130 Sheffield Avenue.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Vic FAQ does not publish a dedicated rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks are prohibited. The venue is cashless and accepts debit and credit cards.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Call the venue directly at 773-472-0449 about ADA accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Vic Theatre does not allow re-entry.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are displayed through AXS Mobile ID on a phone; no paper ticket is required. The Vic box office at 3145 North Sheffield Avenue sells advance tickets, with hours listed in the FAQ.

gates.summary: Doors usually open one hour before showtime; confirm the exact door time on that event’s listing.
